discovery_notes: DLR OE 2019 backfill; 30 WebSearch calls, all search_snippet. Mostly Disney Pins Blog and WDWNT. Many 2019 Disney Parks OE lines were sold at both DLR and WDW. Galaxy's Edge shop-list pins (WDWNT First Order Cargo/Resistance Supply, June 2019, i.e. Disneyland-only period) lack an explicit OE statement. Conflicts kept: Resistance booster 29.99 vs 27.99; First Order mystery 14.99 vs 19.99 LR. 2019 dated mystery may have launched late 2018. Pixar Pier OE not found.
